subject: Staff verification artifacts for SIG questionnaire - onboarding & departures
messages:
From: Linda Kapoor <linda.kapoor@brightlane.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightlane.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG - staff verification artifacts (onboarding/offboarding)

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this — BrightLane is running through the SIG questionnaire and our auditor asked for evidence around employee screening, mandatory security training completions, and deprovisioning timelines for people who left in the last 18 months. Specifically, we need: 1) confirmation that background checks are completed prior to access; 2) a roll-up CSV showing training completion dates and SSO IDs; 3) an example deprovisioning runbook and a sample of a completed deprovisioning ticket.

Would you be able to provide redacted artifacts and a short attestation we can include in the SIG packet? We are aiming to submit by Nov 12.

Best,
Linda Kapoor
Information Security Manager
BrightLane Health

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Linda Kapoor <linda.kapoor@brightlane.com>
Cc: security@brightlane.com, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG - staff verification artifacts (onboarding/offboarding)

Hi Linda — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide a SIG-friendly package.

Short plan:
- I'll assemble a redacted archive of background checks and the training roll-up CSV.
- Monica from HR will provide the deprovisioning runbook and a sample ticket (redacted).
- We will include an attestation that background checks are required for roles with access to customer data and that we enforce training completion before privileged access is granted.

Can you confirm whether a redaction that removes PII (SSNs, birthdates) is acceptable, or do you need fully anonymized hashes? Also, do you want the training CSV to include SSO IDs or just name + completion date?

I'll aim to get the package to you by Nov 8 to allow any follow-ups.

Thanks,

Hi all,

Attached are the artifacts we can share: background_checks_redacted.zip (redacted DOB/SSN, employee IDs hashed), onboarding-training-rollup.csv (columns: role, start_date, training_name, completion_date, sso_id - sso_id is hashed), offboarding-deprovisioning-runbook.pdf, and a redacted ticket export sample.

Notes on scope and controls:
- Background checks: required for engineers, infra, SOC/ops, and anyone with access to customer data; checks are completed pre-offer for some vendors and pre-provisional-access for employees.
- Training: our mandatory security curriculum (SecureDev 101, PhishSim, Data Handling) is tracked in LMS; alerts are created for missing completions and SSO provisioning is gated by completion for privileged roles.
- Deprovisioning: runbook shows IAM entitlement removal within 24 hours of termination; we retain logs of deprovisioning tickets for 3 years in the ticketing system.

I've attached a short attestation paragraph we can include in the package. Let me know if BrightLane needs stronger redaction (e.g., full anonymization).

Attachments (sent): background_checks_redacted.zip (archive, 3 files), onboarding-training-rollup.csv (CSV, 1 file), offboarding-deprovisioning-runbook.pdf (PDF, 1 file)

Regards,
Monica Patel
Head of People Ops, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Thanks — this is very helpful. A couple of follow-ups before we close the checklist:
1) For the training CSV, can you include a column noting whether training was completed prior to granting privileged access (yes/no)?
2) For background checks, BrightLane audit prefers a statement of whether checks are vendor-managed or in-house and the vendor name if applicable.
3) For the deprovisioning ticket sample, can you confirm the timestamp showing IAM removal (we need a concrete example line in the ticket).

If you can send an updated CSV and the attestation text by EOD Nov 9 we'll be able to attach and mark this section complete.

Best,
Linda
